Actors Nalini Nair, Nassar and Pasupathy also revisit favourite Chennai food memories, connecting personal nostalgia with the city’s changing food culture.

title: NASA’s $4 billion Roman telescope to map 2 billion galaxies and uncover secrets of the universe

description: Artificial intelligence is transforming the landscape of cyber warfare by automating intricate tasks. Recent reports depict AI agents taking charge of substantial segments of cyber operations, drastically cutting down the expertise and duration needed for traditional attack strategies. On the flip side, AI also equips cybersecurity professionals with enhanced capabilities to detect weaknesses. This ongoing battle depicts both sides racing to leverage AI innovations to outsmart each other.

description: Anushka Sharma found motherhood strengthened her self-belief and decision-making abilities. She chose to scale back acting to prioritize her daughter's needs. This shift reflects a growing confidence in personal judgment over external validation. Modern parenting often involves intense comparison and pressure to prove sufficiency. Sharma's experience highlights trusting one's understanding of their child and family.

title: He bought a Rs 60 bicycle and cycled 6,000 miles to reach the woman he loved
description: In January 1977, Pradyumna Kumar Mahanandia embarked on a remarkable 6,000-mile cycling adventure to reunite with his Swedish sweetheart. Armed with a bicycle and little else, he encountered kindness from strangers who offered him food, shelter, and funds for his artistic endeavors. After 133 days on the road, he reached Gothenburg, where he and Lotta tied the knot and started their life together in Sweden.

title: Delhi Master Plan 2047: 40L homes, land pooling to reshape NCT's real estate
description: Delhi's Master Plan 2047 sets forth a comprehensive strategy for urban development, emphasizing both the revitalization of existing neighborhoods and the strategic expansion into undeveloped areas. The ambitious proposal aims to generate around forty lakh affordable housing units, supported by initiatives like land pooling to enhance urban infrastructure and ensure accessibility. Additionally, measures will be taken to regularize unauthorized colonies, providing greater security in property ownership.

title: Two hours, 500 metres: How Gurgaon’s rain stole my train
description: A commuter missed their train due to severe waterlogging and traffic jams.  The journey to New Delhi Railway Station became impossible after heavy rainfall began.  Roads remained choked for hours, preventing any significant travel progress.  This recurring infrastructure failure causes financial loss and disrupted plans for residents.  The city's response cycle repeats with every significant downpour.

title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125m school to shut after 10 yrs

Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, prompting the board's unanimous decision to shut down. While offering extensive support services, the school's academic results did not meet state benchmarks. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative is providing financial support for the transition and educational savings accounts.
